title: proud
summary: This article introduces a new regular feature in the magazine: drawing battles. Each issue will now include a themed drawing battle, showcasing various artists' interpretations. The themes for this particular battle range from childhood memories to future aspirations and personal reflections.
excerpt: Damn. Yee! We love drawing battles, and that's why from about now on, there will be one to admire in every issue. This new feature will explore various themes through artistic interpretations, offering a unique and engaging experience for readers. Get ready to see some creative takes on topics ranging from personal memories to future visions.
